topic: A superfan who was kicked out of an arena for dancing shirtless returns 12 years later with his sons to welcome back Kevin Garnett.

script: This guy was the biggest Kevin Garnett fan, so he wanted to honor him while hyping up the crowd. But for some reason, security stepped in and kicked him out of the arena. However, 12 years later, KG would return to play for Minnesota, and the fan was spotted again in the crowd. Everyone in the arena immediately recognized him, and his two sons were hyping him up to do his iconic dance. So they all danced together, as KG's biggest fan revealed a "welcome home" message, which put the biggest smile on KG's face.
